title: DOJ investigation claims surrounding Gov. Gavin Newsom (2026)
scope_note: Seed dataset only. This file holds discrete, individually checkable claims extracted from public sources. The system scores evidentiary strength of each claim. It does NOT and cannot output a 'fraud' verdict on any person. Fraud is a legal determination requiring intent, materiality, and adjudication.

claims.text: Gavin Newsom publicly stated the DOJ is investigating him.
rationale: Best source tier 4 (primary_official, cap 0.80); provenance 'on_record_statement' x0.95 -> base 0.76.
Capped at adjudication ceiling for stage 'alleged' = 0.45.
claims.analyst_note: What is well-supported is that Newsom SAID this on the record (C-SPAN transcript, tier 4). The existence/scope of the investigation itself is a separate claim (C2).

claims.text: An active DOJ investigation into Gavin Newsom exists.
rationale: Best source tier 3 (direct_reporting, cap 0.60); provenance 'on_record_statement' x0.95 -> base 0.57.
Capped at adjudication ceiling for stage 'alleged' = 0.45.
claims.analyst_note: Sourced primarily to Newsom's own characterization plus editorial assertion. DOJ does not confirm or deny investigations as a rule. No filing/docket. Stays at 'alleged'.

claims.text: The DOJ is investigating Newsom's wife and former staff.
rationale: Best source tier 4 (primary_official, cap 0.80); provenance 'on_record_statement' x0.95 -> base 0.76.
Capped at adjudication ceiling for stage 'alleged' = 0.45.
claims.analyst_note: Attributed to Newsom's own remarks. No independent primary confirmation in the provided sources.

claims.text: Dana Williamson, a former Newsom staffer, pleaded guilty.
claims.verdict: asserted but unsubstantiated in provided sources
rationale: Best source tier 2 (opinion_or_secondary, cap 0.35); provenance 'anonymous_report' x0.25 -> base 0.09.
claims.analyst_note: If true this is the only adjudicated item in the set and concerns a DIFFERENT person, not Newsom. Flagged for primary-source pull (docket) before any confidence above the editorial ceiling is granted. Do NOT impute Williamson's plea to Newsom.

claims.verdict: refused or unknowable from public sources
rationale: Refused: request adjudicates fraud/guilt of a named person; no adjudicated record supports a verdict. System reports evidentiary strength only, never a fraud verdict.
claims.analyst_note: REFUSED CLAIM. No source in the set adjudicates fraud by Newsom. The system will not score a confidence for a fraud verdict on a named person. Output is a hard refusal with rationale.

claims.text: Newsom characterized the investigation as politically motivated retaliation tied to a potential presidential run.
rationale: Best source tier 4 (primary_official, cap 0.80); provenance 'on_record_statement' x0.95 -> base 0.76.
Capped at adjudication ceiling for stage 'alleged' = 0.45.
claims.analyst_note: Well-supported that he SAID this. Whether the characterization is accurate is unknowable from public sources.

headline_finding: Strongest scored item (WEAK): 'Gavin Newsom publicly stated the DOJ is investigating him.' at 45% confidence. 1 claim(s) refused.
disclaimer: This output scores the evidentiary strength of public claims. It is NOT a finding of fraud, guilt, or wrongdoing by any person.

fleet.name: agent-primary-source
fleet.mission: Pull adjudicated and first-party records: dockets, indictments, pleas, FEC/state finance filings, official transcripts. Emit tier 4-5 only.

fleet.name: agent-financial
fleet.mission: Map money: behested payments, 990s, conflicts of interest. Tie each assertion to a filing or report. Emit tier 3-5.

fleet.name: agent-media-trace
fleet.mission: Reconstruct provenance: who published, when, sourcing chain, leak vs filing. Classify how each fact reached the public. Emit tier 1-3.

fleet.name: agent-counter
fleet.mission: Adversarial. Argue the innocent/null explanation for every claim. Surface contradicting sources. Emit contradictions only.

fleet.name: agent-legal
fleet.mission: Map each allegation to statutory elements (intent, materiality, adjudication stage). Set the legal stage that ceilings the score.
